budget.gmailMcpServerId.description: The MCP server ID under which the Gmail server is registered (Settings → MCP Servers → row id). Defaults to 'gmail' to match the bundled catalog entry. If you renamed the row on install, update this to match exactly.

budget.gmailQuery.description: Gmail search filter applied to every sync. Defaults to Chase email only. Use Gmail search syntax if you need to add other issuers later.

budget.syncStartDays.description: On the very first sync (no cursor yet), import mail received within this many days. Ignored if budget.syncStartDate is set.

budget.syncStartDate.description: Absolute start date for the very first sync (no cursor yet), as YYYY-MM-DD. When set to a valid date, it pins the exact 'import everything from here' point and takes precedence over budget.syncStartDays. Leave blank to use the relative day window.

budget.syncMaxEmails.description: Gmail page size for each sync batch. Gmail's API ceiling is 500. The default of 100 fetches emails in batches of 100; the sync follows Gmail nextPageToken until all matching pages are exhausted, with an internal safety cap.
